case.rationale: This case evaluates multiple claims to ensure that each rule is applied correctly and that the system handles various scenarios, including inactive plans, non-covered services, out-of-network services, authorization requirements, formulary restrictions, and payout calculations.

case.title: Synthetic Healthcare Workflow Case
case.rationale: This case tests the workflow for a synthetic healthcare software lab, including submission, read, transition, and readback actions, while ensuring compliance with selected rules.

scope: Twelve known authored defect seeds; action-family applicability, not exhaustive mutation coverage. Only assertion mismatches count as detections; infrastructure errors do not.
